scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Two nonlinear U pad discretizations at the identical2339-tet body geometry/mesh/mass

independent_final_field_audit.scope: Reconstruct nonlinear U equilibrium and compare objective fields across resolved contact meshes.
independent_final_field_audit.limitations: Every retained accepted-step residual record is checked; only final complete fields were saved. Independent nonlinear bulk equilibrium is reconstructed with the retained final nodal contact forces, not a missing friction history. Proper finite frames and direct P2 deformation-gradient evaluation at common material points avoid stress interpolation and infinitesimal-rotation assumptions. The declared axis and semantic geometry hashes distinguish coupled, fixed-body pad and fixed-pad body studies. Body CAD/volume and pad geometry/volume/contact resolution still require their own separated checks. Probe norms are diagnostics rather than continuum integrals; two levels cannot establish a tail. Discrete masses are recorded without density retuning. Full history/contact reconstruction, separated axes, refined contact references, native finite footprints, actual Franka, feedback and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain separate requirements.

limitations: Body mesh/geometry/density/mass remain identical across pad5/7. The pad surface geometry, volume and contact discretization still vary together; only final complete fields and original accepted residual records are audited. No missing contact/friction history is invented. Two levels and all changes below3% do not establish a credible physical tail. Pad9, fixed-pad body refinement, complete original history, geometry/contact/model/feedback and verified physical accuracy/cost remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
